tools.title: BambooHR
tools.summary: HR software for employee records, time off, hiring, goals and reports.

servers.name: BambooHR MCP Server
servers.capabilities: Employees and directory, fields, datasets, reports, time off, goals, hiring, global employment and files; mostly read, some write and delete tools.

tools.notes: One endpoint per company subdomain. An admin must enable the AI Connectors app under Settings > Apps; a bearer token is also accepted for scripted use.

tools.title: Factorial
tools.summary: HR software: employees, attendance, time off, tasks and payroll.

servers.name: Factorial MCP Server
servers.capabilities: Clock in and out, view and create tasks, view and request time off, find colleagues, and delegate broader questions to Factorial One.

tools.notes: Actions run under each user's own Factorial permissions; the Factorial One capability needs a plan that includes Factorial One.

tools.title: HiBob
tools.summary: HR platform (Bob) for people data, time off, performance, compensation and hiring.
tools.notes: HiBob runs a hosted, OAuth-based Bob MCP server (product page: supports ChatGPT, Claude.ai, Claude Desktop, Cursor; admin enables it), but its setup is documented only in the Bob Help Center, which could not be read, so no endpoint is listed. A community post cites https://mcp.hibob.com/mcp/public (unconfirmed); legacy service-user access is blocked for new connections since 2026-11-09.

tools.title: Lucca
tools.summary: French HR and finance suite: absences, timesheets, expenses, core HR.
tools.notes: No vendor MCP server found on 2026-11-21; only third-party hosted connectors (StackOne, Apideck, Knit, Vinkius). Use the OAuth 2.0 REST API.

tools.title: PayFit
tools.summary: Payroll and HR software for small and mid-sized companies.
tools.notes: No vendor MCP server found on 2026-11-21 (developers.payfit.io does not mention one); only third-party connectors. The Partner API uses OAuth 2.0 and requires partner access.

tools.title: Personio
tools.summary: HR software for SMEs: employee data, absences, attendance, recruiting and payroll preparation.
tools.notes: Open beta for Core Pro plan customers; an admin enables MCP access, then each user signs in. Not verified: the support article returned 403 and the product page 429 on 2026-11-21, so the endpoint comes from search excerpts of those vendor pages. Personio announces an MCP server (Personio MCP Server); its endpoint could not be read on its own documentation on 2026-11-21, so it is not listed.

tools.title: Workday
tools.notes: Workday announces MCP-based 'Agent-Ready Tools' (workday.com/mcp), but no public endpoint, transport or install command is documented there, so none is listed. Third-party servers (Workato, CData, StackOne) exist; check with your Workday admin.
